title: Noodle Stew
description: This mod adds the Noodle Stew to the game, fills 5 hunger bars and gives a short regeneration effect.
body:
# 🍜 Noodles Stew Mod

Add a simple vanilla-style food item to Minecraft with the new Noodles Stew.

Crafted using basic survival ingredients, Noodles Stew is a lightweight vanilla+ food mod designed to fit naturally into Minecraft without changing the game’s balance or style.

## ✨ Features

* New craftable food item: Noodles Stew
* Fully survival obtainable
* Gives a short Regeneration effect
* Restores 5 hunger bars
* Appears in the creative menu
* Simple vanilla-style recipe
* Lightweight food mod
* Designed for Minecraft 26.1 / Tiny Takeover

## 🧪 Crafting Recipe

Place these items in a horizontal row:

```text id="5v2q8w"
[ Wheat ] [ Water Bottle ] [ Bowl ]
```

## 🍲 Perfect For

* Vanilla+ modpacks
* Survival worlds
* Cozy cooking gameplay
* Small Fabric mod collections
* Players who want more food variety without huge overhaul mods

## ⚙️ Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition 26.1 / 26.1.1
* Fabric Loader
* Singleplayer compatible

A tiny food mod that feels like it could already be part of Minecraft.
